label: TP
reason: User input flows directly through helper classes into a String concatenation/slicing operation that results in writing raw bytes to the HTTP response via PrintWriter. The 'toString()' call on line 26 of Thing2.java converts the concatenated string back to its original form before being returned, meaning no effective sanitization occurs. The final sink writes these characters directly to the response stream.

evidence.note: Writes raw character array from user input to response stream without sanitization.
Concatenates user input with other strings then calls toString() which preserves the malicious content.
